تستقرضن (form X)
# تَسْتَقْرِضْنَ (tastaqriḍna) /tas.taq.ridˤ.na/: second-person feminine plural non-past active indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَقْرَضَ (istaqraḍa)
# تُسْتَقْرَضْنَ (tustaqraḍna) /tus.taq.radˤ.na/: second-person feminine plural non-past passive indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَقْرَضَ (istaqraḍa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
